name: food-delivery-marketplace-dev
description: Root dev orchestrator only. It does not merge backend/, customer-frontend/, or admin-restaurant/ — it just starts all three existing apps together for local development.

scripts.setup: composer install --working-dir=backend && npm install --prefix customer-frontend && npm install --prefix admin-restaurant
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,CUSTOMER,ADMIN -c "#fb923c,#38bdf8,#a78bfa" --kill-others "cd backend && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "npm run dev --prefix customer-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin-restaurant"
